## Read Me

| SAVIOR PLUMBING INC. — FLAT RATE PRICE BOOK |  |
| --- | --- |
| Effective January 2026  \|  Internal use only  \|  Rev. 4 |  |
| Company | Savior Plumbing Inc. |
| Main line | (925) 232-8896 — call or text |
| Service area | Alameda County and Contra Costa County, CA |
| Office hours | Mon-Fri 7:30am - 4:30pm. Sat/Sun closed. Sunday and after-hours by appointment only. |
| Labor warranty | 2 years on labor for all work performed by our technicians. |
| Estimates | Free estimates on most services. Complex/large projects quoted by next business day. |
| Languages | Team is bilingual English / Spanish. |
| HOW TO USE | All prices below are FLAT RATE and include labor. Parts noted where included. Quote the flat rate to the customer BEFORE starting work and get verbal approval. Do not quote hourly. |
| DIAGNOSTIC | The diagnostic fee is waived if the customer approves the repair on the same visit. |
| PERMITS | Not included in any price below. See note on Water Heaters tab. |
| !! TBD !! | After-hours / weekend multiplier has NOT been finalized for 2026. Do not quote after-hours pricing over the phone — take the info and have Marisol call back. |
| !! TBD !! | Commercial pricing is not in this book. All commercial work is custom-quoted by Danny. |
| SAMPLE DATA | Fictional figures created for software testing. These are NOT Savior Plumbing's actual published rates. |
